_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: localized_content_reads
constraints: CHECK (title IS NOT NULL OR subtitle IS NOT NULL OR description IS NOT NULL OR translation IS NOT NULL OR hint IS NOT NULL OR explanation IS NOT NULL)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_preferences" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ui_locale" TEXT NOT NULL, "translation_locale" TEXT NOT NULL, "preferred_accent" TEXT NULL, "theme_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "focus_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("focus_mode" IN (0, 1)), "storage_quota_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installation_runtime_states" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "registration_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_registration_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_token_refresh_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_success_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_manifest_states" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "current_content_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "current_manifest_checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_content_version_seen" INTEGER NULL, "remote_manifest_checksum" TEXT NULL, "etag" TEXT NULL, "last_checked_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_successful_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_runs" ("run_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL, "translation_locale" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_content_version" INTEGER NULL, "target_content_version" INTEGER NULL, "target_schema_version" INTEGER NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "resync_requested" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("resync_requested" IN (0, 1)), "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "retryable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("retryable" IN (0, 1)), "error_code" TEXT NULL, "error_message" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("run_id"), CHECK (attempt_count >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_pack_updates" ("run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sync_runs (run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "pack_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "required_asset_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "verified_asset_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("run_id", "pack_code", "variant_key"), CHECK (target_revision > 0), CHECK (required_asset_count >= 0), CHECK (verified_asset_count >= 0), CHECK (verified_asset_count <= required_asset_count));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_tombstones" ("run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sync_runs (run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "content_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "applied_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("run_id", "content_code", "content_type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_pack_revisions" ("pack_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_content_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "staged_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "verified_at" INTEGER NULL, "current_at" INTEGER NULL, "superseded_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pack_code", "variant_key", "revision"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_content_records" ("content_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, "published_at" INTEGER NULL, "snapshot_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_code", "content_type", "revision"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pack_content_refs" ("pack_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pack_code", "variant_key", "pack_revision", "content_code", "content_type", "content_revision"), CHECK (pack_revision > 0), CHECK (content_revision > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pack_localization_refs" ("pack_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL, "localization_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pack_code", "variant_key", "pack_revision", "content_code", "content_type", "content_revision", "locale"), CHECK (pack_revision > 0), CHECK (content_revision > 0), CHECK (localization_revision > 0), CHECK (length(trim(locale)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(checksum)) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_catalog" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "checksum_sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "delivery_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id"), CHECK (size_bytes > 0), CHECK (duration_ms IS NULL OR duration_ms >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_asset_refs" ("content_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES asset_catalog (asset_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "asset_role" TEXT NOT NULL, "required_offline" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("required_offline" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("content_code", "content_type", "content_revision", "asset_id", "asset_role"), CHECK (content_revision > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pack_asset_refs" ("pack_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "variant_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES asset_catalog (asset_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "required_offline" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("required_offline" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("pack_code", "variant_key", "pack_revision", "asset_id"), CHECK (pack_revision > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_catalog_reads" ("content_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "has_audio" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("has_audio" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_code", "content_type", "revision"), CHECK (revision > 0), CHECK (minutes > 0), CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(category)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(level)) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "localized_content_reads" ("content_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "locale" TEXT NOT NULL, "localization_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "translation" TEXT NULL, "hint" TEXT NULL, "explanation" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_code", "content_type", "content_revision", "locale", "localization_revision"), CHECK (content_revision > 0), CHECK (localization_revision > 0), CHECK (length(trim(locale)) > 0), CHECK (length(trim(checksum)) > 0), CHECK (title IS NULL OR length(trim(title)) > 0), CHECK (subtitle IS NULL OR length(trim(subtitle)) > 0), CHECK (description IS NULL OR length(trim(description)) > 0), CHECK (translation IS NULL OR length(trim(translation)) > 0), CHECK (hint IS NULL OR length(trim(hint)) > 0), CHECK (explanation IS NULL OR length(trim(explanation)) > 0), CHECK (title IS NOT NULL OR subtitle IS NOT NULL OR description IS NOT NULL OR translation IS NOT NULL OR hint IS NOT NULL OR explanation IS NOT NULL));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorites" ("content_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_code", "content_type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_learning_states" ("content_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "listened_at" INTEGER NULL, "listen_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_played_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_position_ms" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "completion_source" TEXT NULL, "last_revision_seen" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_code", "content_type"));
